gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-so: Wide-spaced, marker-straight lettering with barely any capital drama. Noto Sans Old Sogdian takes the quieter job, its tall lowercase staying crisp where Bushcraft is all expressive sprawl.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-tu: Loopy, closed-up letters with a hand-drawn wobble. Noto Sans Old Turkic is the counterweight, its chunky, tall lowercase and open curves doing the plain work that Bushcraft's artistic spacing never could.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya has small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. If Bushcraft gets shrunk down, its closed, widely spaced shapes would clog, while this sans-serif's generous gaps keep going.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-osage: Bent-wire roundness, spaced out and artistic. Bushcraft is best at being looked at, while Noto Sans Osage, with its inflated bowls and sweeping open curves, is best at being read.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-osmany: Bushcraft draws everything in one marker-like line, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase and wide gaps between characters. Noto Sans Osmanya handles the actual reading, its oversized lowercase and easy s curves doing the work.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-pahawh: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sets a high x-height against Bushcraft's wide-spaced, uniform marker strokes, whose horizontals are no thinner than the verticals. Expressive up top, crisp below.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-palmyr: Rod-built letters, widely spaced, with capitals that hardly stand apart from the lowercase. Bushcraft is best for expressive display, while Noto Sans Palmyrene suits modern text with its short ascenders.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-pau-ci: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau has open-ended curves and only a short step from lowercase top to capital top. Bushcraft's rope-thin closed outlines, spaced far apart, leave it the only showy voice, so a longer passage would settle into easy rhythm.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-phagsp: Noto Sans PhagsPa keeps its c openings see-through and its capitals only a gentle bump above the small letters. Bushcraft, with its closed single-weight outlines, is best at artistic display, while Noto Sans PhagsPa is best at everyday text.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-phoeni: Noto Sans Phoenician brings generous lowercase height. Its s curves open wide at both ends, a calm foil to Bushcraft's laser-etched, constant-width line and stretched spacing.
